text: Added the complete-support sparse hot path and caller-owned SparseValueGradientBuffer3 in reframe4s-resample. Coordinates, values, three world-gradient components, validity flags, and counters are primitive arrays; compile and batch validation happen outside the point loop. Each accepted point performs exactly eight ranked Ravel reads, the output scratch is reused, invalid points are zeroed and counted, and the immutable sampler contains no mutable execution state. Shared JVM/JS parity covers canonical and sliced/reversed layouts plus invalid coordinates. JVM allocation is count-independent at 88 bytes for a 32,768-point by 4 batch, with 1,081,344 bytes of preallocated output workspace and 786,432 bytes of coordinate storage recorded separately; median throughput in the gate was 25.009 million samples/s. Concurrent use of one sampler with separate buffers passes. Full resample gates pass 11 JVM and 9 JS tests.
